notes.title: Women's Day Event
notes.content:
# Unleaving Joins the Women's Day Sale on Steam! 🎮 🎉

We're excited to share that *Unleaving* is part of the **Women's Day Sale on Steam** — running from **February 28 to March 9, 2025**! 📅

This special event celebrates the creative power of women 👩‍💻, spotlighting incredible work from across the gaming industry. *Unleaving* was born from a deep passion for art 🎨, storytelling 📖, and pushing the boundaries of video games as a medium.

Thank you for supporting our work and the broader community of creators! 💖 If you haven't played *Unleaving* yet, now is the perfect time to experience the game and celebrate the artistry behind it.

*Unleaving* is on discount with **40% off**! 💰

Check out the Women's Day Sale on Steam to discover more inspiring games! ✨

notes.title: Autumn Sale : Goldengrove 🍂
notes.content:
[h2]Unleaving - Autumn Sale & Goldengrove Inspiration[/h2] 

“Margaret, are you grieving  
Over Goldengrove unleaving?”  

The [b]Steam Autumn Sale[/b] is here, bringing with it the golden hues of fall, the fleeting beauty of Goldengrove, and the transient nature of the season. These themes have deeply inspired the world of [b]Unleaving[/b], a game where every frame feels like a painting.  

Now is the perfect time to celebrate the beauty of fall with art, emotion, and 30% off!🍂

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1076720/Unleaving/

We’re passionate about [b]Bridging Traditional Painting and Video Games[/b]. Recently, we had the chance to partner with the [b]Hand Eye Society[/b] to discuss how traditional mediums can merge with game development. [url=https://www.twitch.tv/videos/2315833941?t=00h33m12s]Check out the talk here[/url]. It’s just one of the many ways we’re constantly exploring new creative possibilities.

notes.title: 6-Month Anniversary Celebration of Unleaving: Bundle Release!
notes.content:
Hello Steam players!

Today, we celebrate the 6-month release of Unleaving on Steam. Your support has been incredible! Since then, we’ve extended the localization to more languages because you asked for it. We also brought the game to Xbox, and it was showcased in the Art Gallery of Ontario as an artistic game.

Your reviews, support, and curiosity inspired us to release an Art Book filled with concept art, heartfelt sketches, and behind-the-scenes insights to share with you. It’s available today as a DLC! 
We have also released the 28-minute Unleaving Soundtrack featuring a mesmerizing blend of atmospheric soundscapes and emotional resonance, composed by the acclaimed Alicia Enstrom.

The Art Book is part of Unleaving's Artistry and Collector's Edition Bundles on Steam.
The Soundtrack is part of Unleaving's Collector's Edition Bundles on Steam.

Thank you for being part of the journey!

notes.title: Unleaving - UPDATE
notes.content:
We're excited to announce an UPDATE for Unleaving, based on your requests and valuable feedback! Here's what's new:

[list]
[*] Added Localization in more languages: Now you can enjoy the game in Portuguese-Brazilian, Russian, Italian, and Turkish.
[*] Experience smoother gameplay: We've increased jumping/push responsiveness, specifically tailored for PCs with minimal requirements.
[*] Improved Hinting System: We've made minor adjustments to our hinting system to provide even better guidance.
[*] Optimized Music Volume: Enjoy a seamless audio experience as we've normalized the music volume.
[/list]

Side note: We wanted to remind players that on instance of dying during Unleaving’s gameplay they can press any key to immediately trigger level restart instead of waiting 3 seconds.

Thank you for supporting indie games and being part of Unleaving’s community. As a token of our gratitude, we're providing a 15% discount to our players this week.

Happy gaming!

notes.title: Unleaving is out now!
notes.content:
[b][h2]Unleaving is Out Now![/h2][/b]

Hello all,

Just as today, we celebrate the release of Unleaving with you!

We are thrilled to announce the release of Unleaving! It is now available on PC, with the Mac release coming soon. Immerse yourself in a world of living paintings with original traditional art assets and mind-bending puzzles. Experience Unleaving for yourself:
[list]
[*] 3-4 hours of gameplay
[*] Unique art and puzzles with no repetition; every scene features original traditional art assets, described as having Van Gogh vibes
[*] A puzzle platformer reminiscent of Limbo with a splash of color; featuring physics-based and timing puzzles to learn from death
[*] Languages: Available in multiple languages
[/list]

notes.title: 48 hours Left to Unleaving: Emotional Launch Countdown!
notes.content:
Hello everyone!

We're 48 hours away from the release of Unleaving the hand painted puzzle platformer, scheduled for March 27th for PC and later for Mac OS! 

Based on your feedback from playing Unleaving's demos at events like PAX East, EGX Rezzed, and during Steam Next Fest and Women's Day sale, we have implemented a number of your ideas and feedback. This includes adding subtle hints in the menu after 5 minutes of gameplay for accessibility and guidance. We are very excited to share the game with you.

Thank you for your ongoing support. Get ready for the experience!


Now back to the grind 🍂

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35019161/1671da53dbf4fe42a5835f63ac61f682f319f597.jpg[/img]

notes.title: 10 Days Left to Unleaving: Emotional Launch Countdown!
notes.content:
Hello everyone!

We're thrilled to share that we're just 10 days away from the release of Unleaving the mind bending new hand painted puzzle game, scheduled for March 27th for PC and later for Mac OS! 

Unleaving's demo was part of The Steam Next Fest and Women's Day Sale, but we wanted to give players who missed it a chance to try the demo, so we kept it a week after the Women's day sale. Now the game is only 10 days away!


Big thanks to the players who already played Unleaving's demo and gave us great feedback! Your input matters! We have taken your feedback into consideration and we've implemented some of the suggestions, it will follow in an update. 


Now back to work  🍂
